'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Western Syria clashes (December 2024–present)|Western Syria clashes]]
***[[2025 massacres of Syrian Alawites]], [[March 2025 Western Syria clashes]]
****The number of civilians reported by one war monitor to be killed in [[extrajudicial killing|extrajudicial massacres]] in western [[Syria]] rises to 1,068, the majority of whom are [[Alawites]] with some [[Christians]] reportedly caught in the violence. '''Arts and culture'''
*The [[Great Lakes Shipwreck Museum|Great Lakes Shipwreck Historical Society]] announce the discovery of the wreckage of the {{Ship|SS|Western Reserve}} that sank in [[Lake Superior]] in 1892, which killed 26 of the 27 people onboard. It was the first [[steel plate]] [[lake freighter]] to operate on the [[Great Lakes]]. [https://apnews.com/article/lake-superior-shipwreck-western-reserve-discovery-d2eec75da48acfb6d1c94c9cc85ce5b1 (AP)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/13/us/shipwreck-lake-superior-western-reserve.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States trade war with Canada and Mexico]]
**[[Ontario]] [[Premier of Ontario|Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces that the province will [[Tariff|charge]] 25% more for [[mains electricity|electricity]] supplied to the [[United States]], which includes the states of [[Michigan]], [[Minnesota]], and [[New York (state)|New York]]. [https://apnews.com/article/canada-ontario-us-trump-tariffs-electricity-834dc3d9defd314923912f9bd8540e31 (AP)]
**[[British Columbia]] [[Premier of British Columbia|Premier]] [[David Eby]] announces that the province will [[Trade prohibition|ban]] all [[Canada–United States trade relations|U.S.-imported]] alcohol within [[BC Liquor Stores|government-operated liquor stores]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/b-c-bans-all-u-s-acohol-1.7479629 (CBC News)]
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**[[New York Stock Exchange|U.S. stocks]] experience a relatively steep drop as the [[Nasdaq Composite]] falls 4% and the [[S&P 500]] falls 2.7%. Economists attribute the drop to [[Closing milestones of the Nasdaq Composite|recent all-time highs]], [[recession]] fears, and concerns about a potential [[Government shutdowns in the United States|U.S. government shutdown]] and the [[Second Trump tariffs|tariffs]] imposed by the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/futures-lower-tariff-worries-continue-tesla-falls-2025-03-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 North Sea ship collision]]
**An [[oil tanker]] is reportedly on fire in the [[North Sea]] off the coast of [[Kingston upon Hull]], [[England]], after [[ship collision|colliding]] with a [[cargo ship]]. Thirty-seven crew members are rescued by [[search and rescue]] boats, with 32 injured and one hospitalized when brought to shore. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cgq1pwjlqq2t (BBC News)] [https://www.dw.com/en/north-sea-37-crew-brought-ashore-after-ship-collision/a-71878602 (DW)]
*Thirty-two people are killed and at least 12 others are injured in two bus crashes in [[Mexico]]. [https://www.observerbd.com/news/516060 (''The Daily Observer'')]
*Three people, including two hospital workers, are killed when a medical transport helicopter crashes in a forested area near [[Tupelo, Mississippi|Tupelo]], [[Mississippi]], [[United States]]. [https://www.irishstar.com/news/us-news/helicopter-crash-kills-three-mississippi-34835266 (''Irish Star'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2025 Organization of American States Secretary General election]]
**The [[Organization of American States]] elects [[Albert Ramdin]] of [[Suriname]] to serve as its [[Secretary General of the Organization of American States|secretary general]] for the 2025–2030 period. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/surinames-albert-ramdin-elected-oas-first-caribbean-secretary-general-2025-03-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Spanish floods]]
**A court charges the dismissed [[Valencian Community|Valencian]] regional minister {{ill|Salomé Pradas|es}} and the former regional secretary of Emergencies for the management of emergency warnings during the floods that caused 228 deaths in October 2024 in the [[Valencian Community]]. [https://elpais.com/espana/2025-03-10/la-jueza-imputa-a-la-exconsejera-de-mazon-que-dirigio-el-dispositivo-de-emergencias-durante-la-dana.html (''El País'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Syrian peace process]]
**The [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian transitional government]] and the [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) sign a [[ceasefire]] and a deal to integrate the SDF into state institutions and bring the [[Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria|Rojava]] region under government control. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/10/syria-merges-kurdish-led-syrian-democratic-forces-into-state-institutions/ (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250310-%F0%9F%94%B4-syria-s-government-signs-deal-with-kurdish-led-authorities-in-the-northeast/ (France24)]
*[[Alexander Turchin]] is appointed [[Prime Minister of Belarus]], succeeding [[Roman Golovchenko]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/lukashenko-appoints-new-belarus-prime-minister/ (''Kyiv Independent'')]
